      "text": "**Investigating Discohook Design**\n\nI\u0027m currently searching for existing Discohook embed templates, specifically related to Minecraft server status and Discord. Seems like I need to integrate a separate bot, perhaps \"Discohook Utils\" or a similar \"Embed Generator,\" to get those interactive buttons working as desired.\n\n\n**Analyzing Embed Elements**\n\nI\u0027m now focusing on replicating the visual elements.       "text": "To recreate this \"Minecraft Server Status\" style in Discord using Discohook, you will need to use an **Embed** with **Inline Fields**.\n\nSince standard webhooks do not support interactive buttons (like the \"Join Game Server\" button), you will need to use a bot alongside Discohook (like **Discohook Utils**) to add that final button.\n\n### Step 1: The Embed Layout (JSON)\nCopy the code below and paste it into the **JSON Data** field at the bottom of the [Discohook](https://discohook.org) website.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"embeds\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Логово Фармил\",\n      \"description\": \"Minecraft • Paper 1.21.11\",\n      \"color\": 3887319,\n      \"thumbnail\": {\n        \"url\": \"https://i.imgur.com/e87b7pS.png\" \n      },\n      \"fields\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Players Online\",\n          \"value\": \"0 / 5\",\n          \"inline\": true\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Server IP\",\n          \"value\": \"51.38.155.237:26938\",\n          \"inline\": true\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Server Status\",\n          \"value\": \"🟢 Online\",\n          \"inline\": true\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Server Location\",\n          \"value\": \"Poland\",\n          \"inline\": true\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n*(Note: Replace the thumbnail URL with a link to your server\u0027s icon if you have one.)*\n\n### Step 2: How to Set it Up in Discohook\n1.  **Webhook URL:** At the top of Discohook, paste your Discord channel\u0027s Webhook URL (find this in Channel Settings \u003e Integrations \u003e Webhooks).\n2.  **Color:** Click the sidebar of the embed in the preview and change the color to a dark gray or a custom hex like `#3B414D` to match the image.\n3.  **Inline Fields:** If you want to add more stats, ensure the \"Inline\" toggle is **ON** for each field. This is what makes them sit side-by-side in a 2x2 grid.\n\n### Step 3: Adding the \"Join\" Button\nDiscord webhooks cannot send buttons by themselves. To get the blue \"Join Game Server\" button:\n1.  Invite the **Discohook Utils** bot to your server.\n2.  Send your embed from the website first.\n3.  In your Discord channel, use the command: \n    `/buttons add message_id:YOUR_MESSAGE_ID style:Link label:Join Game Server url:https://your-server-link.com`\n4.  The bot will then attach the blue button to the bottom of your message.\n\n### Styling Tips to Match the Image:\n*   **Icons:** Use custom Discord emojis in the \"Value\" section (e.g., `:poland:` for the location) to make it look more interactive.\n*   **Formatting:** Use **Bold** text for the values (e.g., `**51.38.155.237:26938**`) to make the important information stand out.\n*   **Author Section:** If you want the server name to look smaller like a header, move \"Логово Фармил\" into the **Author Name** section instead of the **Title**.",

      }, {

      }, {
        "text": " you have one.)*\n\n### Step 2: How to Set it Up in Discohook\n1.  **"
      }, {

        "text": "\n\n### Step 3: Adding the \"Join\" Button\nDiscord webhooks cannot send buttons by themselves. To get"
